property_summary: Only the contract owner may change `rewardsRecipient`; any caller who is not the owner calling `setRewardsRecipient` must not alter `c.rewardsRecipient()`, which the mutant violates since anyone can overwrite it.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can set rewardsRecipient (function signature unchanged; modifiers may be changed per rules).
